provenance.sourcePrompt: Create a transparent RGBA sprite sheet for an original 1990s arcade basketball game: exactly fifteen distinct, separate, complete full-body drawings of the SAME adult human woman basketball athlete, arranged in a perfectly regular 5-column by 3-row grid in strict row-major order, with generous transparent gutters and no touching or clipped figures. Canvas 1619 x 971 pixels, transparent background. Character identity throughout: compact natural athletic build, light warm skin, dark eyes, focused adult face, abundant dark-purple curls gathered high into a rounded curly ponytail with a small gold tie, blank sleeveless Chicago Condas basketball uniform in deep purple with simple gold piping and plain unmarked jersey, dark knee pads, purple-and-gold basketball shoes. Keep face, curl silhouette, body proportions, uniform design, shoes, scale and clean pixel-rich sprite shading consistent across all fifteen poses. Right-facing, profile-to-three-quarter view, motion travels to the right. Do NOT draw a basketball or other object; gameplay renders the ball separately, so hands show a plausible grip around an invisible ball in the gather and dunk poses, and become open/empty after release. Do not draw a hoop, rim, court, floor, shadow, text, lettering, jersey number, logo, border, grid line, panel, glow, opponent, extra player, or background. Each cell contains exactly one athlete. Pose sequence: 0) grounded right-facing approach, arms low and relaxed; 1) gather an imaginary ball with both hands near waist, knees bending; 2) compress deeper, elbows tucked, eyes toward rim; 3) spring upward from both feet, ball in both hands at chest; 4) rising, right arm beginning to lift the imaginary ball, left arm balancing; 5) airborne ascent, ball carried beside the right shoulder; 6) high ascent, extend the right arm overhead, knees bent naturally; 7) peak of the jump, right hand securely holds the imaginary ball above head, compact torso extended; 8) peak transition, bring ball slightly forward overhead with shoulders turned toward target; 9) powerful one-handed overhead reach toward the right, left arm counterbalances; 10) release pose at the imaginary rim, right arm fully extended and fingers open, ball is absent; 11) clear follow-through with open right hand and shoulder extending down; 12) descent, arms lower and legs extend toward landing; 13) feet approach the ground, knees ready to absorb impact; 14) stable two-foot landing and balanced finish, arms relaxed. Crisp authentic digitized-arcade 2D sprite art, strongly readable silhouette and limbs, consistent anatomy and lighting, no motion blur. Verify all fifteen bodies are fully separated and inside their own cells.

cleanup.method: Only strongly red pixels connected through same-colored pixels to already transparent background were cleared; the four outermost image edges were set transparent. Dark outlines and interior pixels were retained.

review.scope: 15 original Juniper Vale power-dunk poses, canonical identity and human anatomy, no baked ball, clean transparency, complete separated bodies
review.notes: Reviewed on white and black compositing. The accepted sheet contains fifteen complete, separated human Juniper drawings in 5x3 row-major order. Her light warm skin, dark eyes, compact athletic build, abundant dark-purple high ponytail with small gold tie, blank purple/gold Condas uniform, dark knee pads, and purple/gold shoes remain consistent. Gather poses have invisible-ball hand shapes; release and follow-through hands are empty. No basketball, hoop, court, text, number or prop is drawn. The accepted raw edit had red exterior fringe; conservative alpha cleanup removed only red pixels connected to transparent background. All poses retain transparent gutters and no clipped pixels.
